style_suffix: Deep green and cool grey palette, soft diffused overcast light, no harsh contrast. Cinematic nature documentary photography, ultra-detailed texture. No people, no animals, no text, no camera movement, no cuts. Calm, meditative, endless gentle motion.

shots.prompt: Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Ancient old-growth temperate rainforest at dawn: towering red cedar and Douglas fir trunks receding into thick silver fog. Soft god-rays slant down through the canopy, catching drifting motes and slow-moving mist that curls between the trunks. Hanging moss sways almost imperceptibly.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Close view of a bigleaf maple whose every branch is draped in thick shaggy club moss, long green beards swaying slowly in a faint breeze. Pale fog drifts through the branches behind, softening the background to grey.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A shallow forest creek running clear over rounded moss-covered stones, water braiding and glinting endlessly around the rocks. Ferns lean in from the banks. Thin mist hangs just above the surface.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Dense sword fern understory on the rainforest floor, hundreds of fronds trembling and nodding in a slow breeze. Soft shafts of light filter through from above. Fog sits in the deep background between dark trunks.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A slender waterfall pouring down a moss-blanketed rock face into a dark green plunge pool, spray drifting and rippling outward continuously. Ferns and dripping moss frame the edges of the falls.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A great fallen nurse log carpeted in emerald moss with a row of young hemlock saplings growing from its spine. Low mist drifts slowly across the forest floor around it, light shifting gently.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Rain dripping steadily from conifer needles and moss onto the fern layer below, each droplet catching the light as it falls. Water beads gather and release on the greenery. Soft grey rainy atmosphere, background dissolving into fog.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A still dark pool on the forest floor mirroring the tall trunks above, its surface stirred by the faintest ripples. Pale fog drifts slowly across the water, continually reshaping the reflection.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Broad shafts of morning light cutting diagonally through mist between huge cedar trunks, landing on a glowing patch of ferns. Motes and vapour drift slowly through the beams, the light breathing gently brighter and softer.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. A wide slow river bend in deep rainforest, dark green water sliding past mossy banks, faint mist rising continuously off the surface. Conifers crowd both shores and fade into fog upstream.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Large moss-capped boulders sitting mid-stream, cold clear water rushing and swirling in white threads around and between them. Wet stone glistens. Ferns and fog fill the background.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Looking up into the high canopy of an old-growth conifer forest, immense trunks converging overhead as thick fog rolls slowly through the branches, alternately hiding and revealing the treetops. Diffused pale sky beyond.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Steady soft rain falling on a still forest pond, endless overlapping rings spreading and crossing on the dark surface. Moss-covered logs and fern fringe at the edges, treeline dissolving into grey mist behind.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Extreme close view of dew-heavy lichen and moss on a branch, droplets trembling and slowly swelling on fine filaments. Behind, a wall of soft grey fog drifts, throwing the background completely out of focus into gentle bokeh.

Static locked-off camera, single continuous unbroken shot. Wide elevated view over an endless conifer valley, thick white fog rolling slowly through the treetops in layered banks, ridgelines fading paler into the distance. Continuous drifting motion across the whole frame.
